Method of Attack: Fileless malware campaign dropping LOLBins and legitimate Node.js and WinDivert tools to infect Windows computers and turn them into proxies; multi-stage infection process starting with drive-by browser compromise, execution of HTA file, JavaScript and PowerShell scripts running in memory only; disabling Windows Defender Antivirus and Windows Update, privilege escalation via shellcode, packet capture and filtering with WinDivert, final Node.js payload zombifying machines; used for click-fraud and stealthy network infrastructure to evade detection
Impacted Systems: Windows computers, home users in U.S. and Europe, organizations in education, business and professional services, healthcare, finance, retail
Indicators of Compromise: Use of legitimate LOLBins: mshta.exe, powershell.exe, node.exe, Windivert.dll/sys
Encoded PowerShell commands in deadbeef environment variable
Downloaded modules: PowerShell scripts, shellcodes, WinDivert library, Node.exe, appjs JavaScript module
Anomalous usage of MSHTA.exe detected by Microsoft Defender ATP telemetry
